visual.issue: Photo 2 is captioned 'Book page, close up' but shows the whole page shrunk on a tablet; field labels are tiny at Etsy zoom and the brief promised the top of the page at reading size (r013).

Month pages hold only 8 'Books finished' lines and the year page 10 squares per month, and neither page nor listing says where it stops; a reader who finishes more books in a month runs out of room (r011).

Photos 4 to 7 also show whole pages shrunk into tablets, so page text is small at Etsy zoom (r013); the cropped tablets also cut off the bottom of each page and the DEC tab, which can look like a cropping mistake.

Hero photo: the front tablet is mostly an empty ivory cover and the Book 1 page behind it is hidden except its header, so the hero shows little of the inside; the point 'Goodnotes, Notability and Android' mixes apps with a platform.
Cover is largely empty above and below the title block (about two thirds blank).
Start here 'The top bar, on every page' box lists Library, TBR and Quotes but leaves out Home, leaving an empty quarter; the Setup check map does include Home.

Start here step 1 is 'Open it in a note app' but its Go there button opens Contents, which needs the explaining line 'This button opens Contents'; step cards also have large empty space below the buttons.
Contents: the Notes card sits alone in the third row with two empty slots beside it.
Setup check eyebrow 'SETUP CHECK' repeats the heading word for word; the 'Where things are' box has oversized gaps between rows.
The J of the 'January' and 'July' headings hangs left of the page margin.
quotes2 and notes2 have no back arrow to page 1, and Notes is not in the top bar, so getting back to Notes page 1 takes Home then Notes.
Reading year has one YEAR line and rows fixed January to December; a buyer starting in October fills Oct to Dec and then wraps into next year's January with no way to mark it.
